How to play

Goal: protect your team's 🛏 bed and break everyone else's. While your bed stands you respawn. Once it's gone, your next death is final.

Resources: stand on your generator for iron and gold. Bridge to the diamond islands for 💎 (team upgrades) and to mid for emeralds. Spend them at the Item Shop and Upgrades NPCs.

The void: walking won't make you fall off. But get knocked back, blown up, or lose the block under your feet and you're gone.

Controls
WASD / arrows: move  ·  Mouse: aim  ·  Shift or double-tap: sprint  ·  Space: jump
Hit someone while falling from a jump for a critical hit. Sprint-hits knock people back harder.
Left click: swing your sword, break blocks and beds (hold to keep mining)
Right click: place blocks (hold and walk to bridge)
1–9 / scroll: switch items  ·  E: talk to a shop NPC
Bow: hold left click to charge, release to shoot
Q: quick chat  ·  Tab: scoreboard

🎙️ Proximity voice: you automatically hear players near you (about 9 blocks) — they get quieter as they walk away. Press 🎙️ Talk to turn on your mic, and V (or the button) to mute it. Turning game sound off (🔊) also silences voices.

Phone: joystick to move (push it all the way to sprint). ⚔️ attacks — with nobody nearby it turns into ⛏️ and mines the block or bed you’re facing (it’s highlighted). 🧱 places a block in front of you; hold it while walking to bridge. ✨ uses your held item.
